name: Bingo
description: Bingo is a benchmark designed to evaluate hallucination behaviors in visual language models, focusing on two common types: bias and interference. It assesses models like GPT-4V(ision) on their tendencies to hallucinate due to training data imbalances and their vulnerability to prompt phrasing and input presentation, highlighting regional biases and challenges in interpreting complex visual inputs.
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark for studying hallucination in vision-language models, especially bias and prompt/interference effects.
notes: Focuses on hallucination challenges in visual language models; identifies regional bias and interference vulnerabilities; mitigation approaches like self-correction are ineffective.
